scope.question: Does replacing only the original two strong-teacher primary terms with an own all-data GRU parent history target improve the matched seed-3 student recipe?

decision_basis.source_tree_relation: 53 unchanged V3 files; two focused V4 modifications; four V4 source/test additions; V3 tree remains intact

parent_dependency.claim_limit: Parent was trained on every supplied train and valid group. Its exported predictions are training targets for this final all-data student, not held-out evidence.

base_cache_dependency.family_array_action: retain original files byte-for-byte and load them from the base cache root; do not duplicate or rebuild them
base_cache_dependency.mandatory_validation: Existing V3 validator performs full source/family file hashes and finite checks when the history cache is built and again when the student trainer validates it; this is retained and budgeted.

target_recipe.accumulation: FP64 chunk-order source-minus-seed3-minus-seed4-plus-parent, one FP32 cast after accumulation
target_recipe.family_targets: Keep four raw family arrays unchanged from the V3 base cache; family loss remains 0.1.
target_recipe.teacher_prediction_precision: Parent A: feature-only FP32 inference. Existing strong seed3/seed4 teacher exports: retain original verified source sidecars (FP16 inference, float32 stored arrays). Other primary sources remain the unchanged base aggregate.
target_recipe.loss_application: The unchanged trainer clips primary targets at ±2 for loss, mixes 0.30*clipped label + 0.70*clipped primary teacher target, and keeps existing weighted WMSE/masks; family loss remains separate at 0.1 with raw targets.

sequence: Independent root review of source manifest, exporter, cache validator and trainer family-cache routing.
After H218 GPU job terminates and its exporter/grade reservations release, separately admit train and valid FP32 parent exports; bind actual checkpoint and group hashes.
After both exports validate, freshly admit bounded CPU-only history cache build with disk/RAM reserve; preserve partial failures under new output ID.
Run independent source-compatible parent-load and fresh-head mapping checks on V4; keep all existing H230 lineage receipts.
Only after explicit root recipe review and fresh per-student GPU admission may the matched seed3 history student fit launch.
failure_policy: Preserve every export, cache-build, load-check and fit attempt. Never mutate V3, base cache, parent or teacher predictions. Any retry receives a new attempt/run/output ID and fresh resource admission.
